fairness.notes: All libraries share learning_rate, max_depth, n_estimators, row/column subsampling, and seed. LightGBM additionally needs subsample_freq>=1 for bagging to apply at all, and num_leaves=2**max_depth so its leaf-wise growth reaches the same capacity as the depth-wise peers.
